title: LINQ Complete Cheat Sheet
description: Comprehensive quick reference for LINQ: method and query syntax, filtering, joins, grouping, aggregation, set operations, and advanced operators.

data.text: Language Integrated Query (LINQ) provides a unified syntax for querying data from objects, databases, XML, and more.

data.title: Method vs Query Syntax
data.content: Two syntaxes for the same operations.

Aggregate Functions
data.code:
List<int> numbers = new() { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };

numbers.Count();                    // 5
numbers.LongCount();                // 5L
numbers.Sum();                      // 15
numbers.Average();                  // 3
numbers.Min();                      // 1
numbers.Max();                      // 5

// Custom aggregation
numbers.Aggregate((a, b) => a * b); // 120

// Boolean tests
numbers.Any();                      // true
numbers.Any(n => n > 3);           // true
numbers.All(n => n > 0);           // true
numbers.Contains(3);               // true

data.title: Set Operators
Element Operators
data.code:
List<int> numbers = new() { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };

numbers.First();                  // 1
numbers.First(n => n > 3);        // 4
numbers.FirstOrDefault();         // 1
numbers.FirstOrDefault(n => n > 10); // 0 (default)

numbers.Last();                   // 5
numbers.LastOrDefault();          // 5

numbers.Single(x => x == 3);      // 3 (exactly one)
numbers.SingleOrDefault(x => x == 3); // 3

numbers.ElementAt(2);             // 3
numbers.ElementAtOrDefault(10);   // 0
